name: Keelboat racing marks 2026: the Port of Cork laid race marks the Autumn League Sailing Instructions position, and East Mark the General Sailing Instructions do, the harbour navigation buoys from eOceanic's list and local knowledge, Cage as the club gave it, and every other mark the course card names

notes.title: Positions
notes.text: Port of Cork Laid Race Marks are yellow permanently laid and may be in these approximate locations.

marks.source: General Sailing Instructions for Royal Cork Yacht Club Keelboat Racing 2026, 22.3

marks.name: Dutchman
marks.placement: The Dutchman mark will be a ‘laid’ club racing mark positioned approx. 2 cables SE of the Dutchman Rock/Fennels Bay.

marks.name: Curlane
marks.placement: “Curlane” will be a mark laid on the Curlane Bank.

marks.name: White Bay
marks.placement: Named by course 73 only; the card says nothing of where it is beyond its name, White Bay being the bay on the harbour's east shore north of Roches Point.
